actions.action: Freeze membership at a committed change version.
actions.mechanism: A session traverses IDs existing at cutoff V, not historical field values.
actions.implementation: Store immutable birth versions and deletion versions. Atomically replace deleted records with membership tombstones. Publish V only after all changes through V commit.
actions.check: Eligibility is birth_version ≤ V and deletion_version absent or > V. Later inserts are excluded; later deletes return ID-only deletion markers.
actions.risk: Requires globally ordered committed versions; per-record counters alone are insufficient.

actions.action: Replace offsets with an immutable-ID cursor.
actions.mechanism: Strict keyset traversal prevents shifting positions from duplicating or skipping eligible IDs.
actions.implementation: Index the combined live/tombstone membership store by immutable ID. Seek strictly after the cursor ID; apply cutoff eligibility before emitting entries.
actions.check: Insert and delete around page boundaries. Concatenated results must equal eligible IDs in ID order, with every ID appearing exactly once.
actions.risk: Live-to-tombstone transitions must preserve an atomically readable membership entry.

actions.action: Expire sessions before retained history disappears.
actions.mechanism: A bounded cursor lifetime makes the membership promise compatible with 24-hour tombstones.
actions.implementation: Issue authenticated cursors containing cutoff, position, filters, tenant and a fixed ten-minute expiry. Retain tombstones for 24 hours; reject expired cursors explicitly.
actions.check: Verify page requests cannot extend expiry, alter filters or cross tenants. Expired requests must require restart, never silently switch datasets.
actions.risk: Ten minutes is a proposed policy, not measured user coverage.

actions.action: Bound scanning, not just returned page size.
actions.mechanism: Candidate-work limits prevent invisible inserts and tombstones from causing unbounded scans.
actions.implementation: Use indexed seeks and a measured candidate cap with deadline headroom. Permit short or empty nonterminal pages; advance the cursor to the last examined ID.
actions.check: Under mutation-heavy load, verify every request meets 300 ms and continuation eventually returns all eligible IDs without duplicates.
actions.risk: A hard latency guarantee still requires bounded store latency and load.

actions.action: Alternatively browse a published ID manifest.
actions.mechanism: A shared immutable manifest fixes membership without reconstructing eligibility on every page.
actions.implementation: Build sorted, deduplicated ID manifests in the existing store; publish only completed generations. Pin sessions for ten minutes. Promise exactly that manifest's IDs, not start-time membership.
actions.check: Exclude inserts absent from the manifest; return deletion markers for missing IDs. Compare traversal against manifest contents and test requests against 300 ms.
actions.risk: Build-time membership may be stale; manifests consume storage and write capacity.

actions.action: Test complete traversal against an independent oracle.
actions.mechanism: Set equality detects omissions; multiplicity checks detect duplicates that set comparisons hide.
actions.implementation: Seed 80,000 IDs. Log committed mutations independently; interleave inserts, deletes and page requests, including six-page, two-minute schedules and complete traversals.
actions.check: For completed sessions, assert returned-ID set equals promised membership and every count equals one. For partial sessions, assert the exact expected prefix.
actions.risk: Use unique page continuations; retries legitimately repeat the same logical page.
